build_SO2_m_Convolution: build an SO2_m_Convolution module to perform SO(2) convolution on features for a specific spherical harmonic order m
build_SO2_Convolution: build an SO2_Convolution module to perform SO(2) convolutions across all spherical harmonic orders with optional radial function weighting
build_SO2_Linear: build an SO2_Linear module to perform SO(2) linear transformations across all spherical harmonic orders with optional radial function weighting
review_SO2_m_Convolution_forward: review the SO2_m_Convolution forward method that applies a linear layer then combines real and imaginary components via rotation
review_SO2_Convolution_forward: review the SO2_Convolution forward method that processes m=0 separately then iterates over m>0 orders with radial modulation
